rule.centre: full outer s/p shell, frozen relation degree 0, principal_n >= 2
rule.ligand: frozen relation degree 1 and ABOVE_HALF shell branch
rule.energetics: no stability claim; evaluate separately with conventional local-minimum and dissociation controls

motivating_primary_sources.role: valence photoelectron spectrum and molecular-orbital ordering
ab initio orbital analysis explicitly illustrating the three-centre bond
CCSD(T) treatment of linear ground-state KrF2 and dissociation energetics
low-temperature X-ray structures plus theoretical studies

heldout_policy.anti_fit: Do not delete a candidate after external energetic evidence is opened. Append energetic/local-minimum labels in a new artifact.

nonclaims: q_cs is not an excitation energy or oxidation state
3c4e candidate generation does not imply thermodynamic stability
KrF2 is a motivating known case and is not counted as blind validation
Ne/Ar candidates are not asserted to exist merely because the structural gate generates them
